# Journey v0.2.2

Journey 0.2.2 is the clean beta release artifact for the 0.2.1 hardening work.

## Highlights

- Keeps the 0.2.1 production-hardening changes:
  - library borrowing end-to-end example
  - domain-agnostic FastAPI route generation
  - duplicate checks derived from the created entity's unique field
  - authenticated actor/session validation
  - generated-test token auto-threading
  - lightweight route/source metadata and drift checks
- Removes automatic PyPI publishing from the release workflow until PyPI Trusted Publishing is configured.
- Ships wheel and source distribution through GitHub Releases.

## Install

```bash
python -m pip install https://github.com/sharziki/journey/releases/download/v0.2.2/journey_lang-0.2.2-py3-none-any.whl
```

## Release Checks

- `python -m pytest -q`
- explicit CLI e2e test
- `journey validate examples/lightweight_client_portal`
- `journey doctor examples/lightweight_client_portal`
- `journey diff examples/lightweight_client_portal --check`
- strict validation and generated acceptance tests for every `examples/*.journey`
- clean wheel install smoke against `examples/library_borrowing.journey`
- `python -m build`
- `python -m twine check dist/*`
